scope: Full identity and integrity verification of every generated payload in all 154 sealed runs. Scientific acceptance is separate; summary runs never generated full per-request raw trajectories.
current_experiment_cleanup: User explicitly declined; all logs retained.
verifier_cpu_accounting: Individual Process CPU is the Windows venv launcher only and can omit its child interpreter. Use the whole parallel verification wall window x 16 logical CPUs as a conservative budget bound.
